zone._doc: Phase 3c: underneath zone matching (play/coverage.ts ZoneMatcher). A receiver entering a zone defender's area (landmark +- w, depth minDepth..zone depth + maxExtra past the LOS) is his; he is released releaseMargin yd past the edge and the next zone defender whose area he enters picks him up (handoff). sink: how far the defender works from his landmark toward the matched receiver; leash: max lateral share of w he leaves the landmark. ballReadFactor: zone defenders face the QB and break on a throw after this share of their reaction (man defenders add manBallReadDelay).
